en: The List of One Hundred and Eight Names of Gaurī

Oṃ, salutation to the power of the great jewel of the mind (mahāmanonmaṇīśakti). Oṃ, salutation to the power of Śiva (śivaśakti). Oṃ, salutation to the one who brings about auspiciousness (śivaṃkarī). Oṃ, salutation to her whose nature consists of the power of will, the power of action, and the power of knowledge (icchā-śakti, kriyā-śakti, jñāna-śakti). Oṃ, salutation to the bliss of the kalā beyond peace (śāntyatīta-kalānandā). Oṃ, salutation to the Māyā of Śiva (śivamāyā). Oṃ, salutation to the beloved of Śiva (śivapriyā). Oṃ, salutation to the all-knowing one (sarvajñā). Oṃ, salutation to the beautiful one (sundarī). Oṃ, salutation to the gentle one (saumyā). Oṃ, salutation to her whose form is existence, consciousness, and bliss (saccidānanda-rūpiṇī). Oṃ, salutation to her who consists of the supreme and the non-supreme (parāparāmaya).

Oṃ, obeisance to Bālā. Oṃ, obeisance to Tripurā. Oṃ, obeisance to Kuṇḍalī. Oṃ, obeisance to Śivā. Oṃ, obeisance to Rudrāṇī. Oṃ, obeisance to Vijayā. Oṃ, obeisance to Sarvā. Oṃ, obeisance to Śarvāṇī. Oṃ, obeisance to Bhuvaneśvarī. Oṃ, obeisance to Kalyāṇī. Oṃ, obeisance to Śūlinī. Oṃ, obeisance to Kāntā. Oṃ, obeisance to Mahātripurasundarī. Oṃ, obeisance to Mālinī. Oṃ, obeisance to Māninī.

Oṃ, salutation to Madanollāsamohinī. Oṃ, salutation to Maheśvarī. Oṃ, salutation to Mātaṅgī. Oṃ, salutation to Śivakāmā. Oṃ, salutation to Citātmikā. Oṃ, salutation to Kāmākṣī. Oṃ, salutation to Kamalākṣī. Oṃ, salutation to Mīnākṣī. Oṃ, salutation to Sarvasākṣiṇī. Oṃ, salutation to Umādevī. Oṃ, salutation to Mahākālī. Oṃ, salutation to Sāmā. Oṃ, salutation to Sarvajanapriyā. Oṃ, salutation to Citpurā.

Oṃ, salutation to the one who is the mass of consciousness and bliss. Oṃ, salutation to her who consists of consciousness. Oṃ, salutation to her whose nature is consciousness. Oṃ, salutation to Mahāsarasvatī. Oṃ, salutation to Durgā. Oṃ, salutation to Jvālādurgādimohinī. Oṃ, salutation to Nakulī. Oṃ, salutation to Śuddhavidyā. Oṃ, salutation to her whose form is existence, consciousness, and bliss. Oṃ, salutation to Suprabhā. Oṃ, salutation to Suprabhājvālā. Oṃ, salutation to Indrākṣī. Oṃ, salutation to Sarvamohinī.

Oṃ, salutation to her who stands in the midst of Mahendra’s net. Oṃ, salutation to Māyā. Oṃ, salutation to Māyāvinodinī. Oṃ, salutation to Viśveśvarī. Oṃ, salutation to Vṛṣārūḍhā. Oṃ, salutation to Vidyājālavinodinī. Oṃ, salutation to Mantreśvarī. Oṃ, salutation to Mahālakṣmī. Oṃ, salutation to Mahākālīphalapradā. Oṃ, salutation to Caturvedaviśeṣajñā. Oṃ, salutation to Sāvitrī. Oṃ, salutation to Sarvadevatā. Oṃ, salutation to Mahendrāṇī.

Oṃ, salutation to Gaṇādhyakṣā. Oṃ, salutation to Mahābhairavapūjitā. Oṃ, salutation to Mahāmāyā. Oṃ, salutation to Mahāghorā. Oṃ, salutation to Mahādevī. Oṃ, salutation to Malāpahā. Oṃ, salutation to Mahiṣāsurasaṃhārī. Oṃ, salutation to Caṇḍamuṇḍakulāntakā. Oṃ, salutation to Cakreśvarī. Oṃ, salutation to Caturvedī. Oṃ, salutation to Sarvadā. Oṃ, salutation to Suranāyikā. Oṃ, salutation to Ṣaṭśāstranipuṇā.

Oṃ, salutation to Nityā. Oṃ, salutation to Ṣaḍdarśanavicakṣaṇā. Oṃ, salutation to Kālarātri. Oṃ, salutation to Kalātītā. Oṃ, salutation to Kavirājamanoharā. Oṃ, salutation to Śāradātilakākārā. Oṃ, salutation to Dhīrā. Oṃ, salutation to Dhīrajanapriyā. Oṃ, salutation to Ugrabhāryā. Oṃ, salutation to Mahābhāryā. Oṃ, salutation to Kṣipramāryā. Oṃ, salutation to Raṇapriyā. Oṃ, salutation to Annapūrṇeśvarī. Oṃ, salutation to Mātṛ.

Oṃ, salutations to her whose radiance is like that of gold and lightning. Oṃ, salutations to her who is the source of the emergence of vowels and consonants. Oṃ, salutations to her who is the cause of prose, poetry, and so forth. Oṃ, salutations to her who is the abode of words and the meanings of sentences. Oṃ, salutations to her who is the cause of the *bindu*, *nāda*, and other subtle sounds. Oṃ, salutations to the queen of the Lord of Liberation. Oṃ, salutations to Satī. Oṃ, salutations to her who bestows the fruits of worldly enjoyment and liberation. Oṃ, salutations to the giver of higher knowledge (*vijñāna*). Oṃ, salutations to Wisdom (*prajñā*). Oṃ, salutations to her who bestows the fruit of supreme wisdom (*prajñāna*).
Oṃ, salutation to her who has transcended the power of egoism. Oṃ, salutation to the Supreme Power (Parāśakti). Oṃ, salutation to her who is higher than the highest (Parātparā).
Thus ends the list of one hundred and eight names of Gaurī.
